Follower.title: Followers
Follower.registerHint: Select an existing NPC granted by the rules or explicitly approved by the GM. Target an unlinked token to use its actual Actor.
Follower.source: Grant / source confirmed by the GM
Follower.healthHint: NPC Health is often three times level. Confirm the growth for this actual follower; existing damage is preserved.
Follower.tasks: Task levels: one label=level per line
Follower.extraLevels: Additional level improvements granted by the GM
Follower.replaceHint: The selected replacement inherits the original numeric profile, acquisition tier and all recorded improvements. The old NPC remains unchanged.
Follower.reconcileHint: Inspect and correct the NPC first. This adopts its current level and maximum Health as the corrected baseline, retaining recorded improvements and current Health.
Follower.unavailable: Follower operation unavailable: check ownership, source, role and progression.
Follower.helpHint: Available followers help according to their role, separately from PC cooperation. All assets share the same cap. Select a specific task level in roll options when it applies.
